| AI front & back office for home-service businesses

"Can someone come today?"

For a homeowner, it's one question. For a service business, there's a job to assess, a technician to schedule, and a customer to look after.

ServiceAgent brings AI into the day-to-day running of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and other home-service businesses, handling the office work around every job.

01

Know what the job needs

Answer calls around the clock, ask trade-specific questions, capture job details, and identify requests that need urgent attention.

02

Get the right visit booked

Turn service requests into appointments, coordinate technician availability, and handle schedule changes as the day unfolds.

03

Keep customers in the loop

Send confirmations, reminders, and updates, with the details of each job available when customers call back.

04

See the job through to payment

Keep estimates, invoices, payments, and follow-ups connected to the work, with less office administration between jobs.

05

Make today's customers tomorrow's business

Stay in touch after the job with timely follow-ups, review requests, and opportunities to bring customers back.

Built for the trade, down to the details.

An emergency plumbing repair, an AC breakdown, and a roof inspection each come with different questions, urgency, and scheduling needs. ServiceAgent accounts for the differences.

Explore ServiceAgent See it in action
| The CRM-friendly business phone system

"You have my details, right?"

Your CRM holds the context. JustCall puts it to work through calls, texts, and AI, then brings the outcomes back to inform what happens next.

01

Make the calling hour count

Reach more prospects with Power, Dynamic, or Predictive dialing, using CRM context and call outcomes to guide your next attempt.

02

Be there when customers call

Route callers by need and availability, with AI answering the calls you choose and your team ready to step in.

03

Carry the conversation into SMS

Trigger timely texts from CRM activity or call outcomes, with two-way replies and follow-ups connected to the customer record.

04

Give AI a job and a goal

Shape voice agents around your business knowledge, qualification criteria, and desired outcomes, with clear rules for human handoffs.

05

Make the next conversation better

Turn calls into summaries, AI scores, and coaching insights that help managers spot gaps and reps improve their next conversation.
